title: Encoder configurations and evaluation coverage

conventions.fold_combination: within-seed: mean of fold AUCs; retrieval hits pooled over folds
conventions.difference: paired by seed, then mean and sample SD of the per-seed differences
conventions.ood_interval: saved 95% paired query bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 0

caption: Encoders (Sentence-Transformers, \texttt{trust\_remote\_code}; cosine similarity). Above the rule: also used in the primary experiments and OOD transfer; below: ten-encoder study only. In-distribution documents (and so queries) carry $^a$the prefix \texttt{query:\textvisiblespace} or $^b$the named prompt \texttt{passage}, otherwise no prompt; OOD targets never do. Maximum sequence length: model default, not recorded. Recorded model revisions are in the accompanying data file.
